subject: Budget feasibility: waterproof gardening guide, £25 delivered retail, 50–500 copies
body:
Hello,

I am planning a waterproof reference product for UK gardeners, sold directly at approximately £25 including customer postage. Could you advise on feasibility and provide non-binding budget prices for 50, 100, 250 and 500 complete products? This is an enquiry, not an order.

We are exploring a manufacturing target around £6–£8 per product, with inbound delivery and VAT itemised separately. Please say if that is unrealistic, and suggest the most useful specification changes or production quantity.

Please compare portrait A4 (210 × 297 mm) and 185 × 240 mm. If 180 or 190 mm width uses your press sheets more efficiently, please advise.

A. Full-colour duplex wire/coil-bound book: 134 interior pages / 67 leaves plus two durable covers printed outside only. Total 69 physical leaves, 136 printed sides, 138 side positions including blank cover insides.

B. If available, removable sheets: 72 leaves / 144 side positions (135 printed and 9 blank), multiple distinct designs collated into each complete set, punched and supplied in a strong wipe-clean ring binder. Please price optional dividers separately.

All pages should withstand water, soil and repeated wiping. Please recommend economical synthetic interiors, preferably around 120–150 microns if sufficiently opaque and durable, with heavier covers. Please state stock brand, gsm and micron thickness, and comment on ink abrasion, hole fatigue and outdoor use. A heavier-stock comparison would help if practical.

Please itemise setup, printing, finishing, binding/folder, collation, packing, UK delivery assumptions and VAT. Please also give estimated finished weight/thickness, lead times, material-sample availability, the price of one printed prototype, and required bleed, binding margins and PDF specification.

The full content exists at A4; custom layouts are still being planned and page counts are provisional. Please reply by email. If the full waterproof collection cannot approach the target, please distinguish any alternative's changes to durability or content.

Many thanks,
John Lennon
status: Both sends returned Gmail SENT labels. This confirms sending, not delivery or a supplier response.
